title: The Bet Machine
description: A real Omen prediction market on Gnosis, replayed bet by bet: eight AI-agent trades walked P(YES) from 50% to 42% in 13 hours. Tap any bet to rewind the pools, then step in as the ninth bettor — set your estimate, bankroll, and stake, and compare it to the Kelly bet an agent would place.
controls: tap a dot on the timeline to rewind the market to that bet
drag the sliders — your P(YES) estimate, bankroll, and stake
tap “size like an agent” for the Kelly-optimal stake

dataSource.label: Omen FPMM 0x6798…6F65 on Gnosis via Blockscout
